Supplied unpainted.

products.title: 10th Birthday Event Support pack
products.body_html:
2026 is our 10th our Birthday! Our Event support packs this year are all filled with Birthday extras in the form of party hats and limited print stickers for every participant! if you have more players than there are hats and sticker let Mick know and he'll pack more:) 

Bronze
Limited edition metal Moonstone coin set, with 1x40mm Elrich coin for the overall winner and 4x30mm coins depicting each faction logo for the best player in each faction.
Certificates for Winner and Best painted. Comes with 8 Stickers and party hats. 

Silver
All of the above plus a limited edition Melee deck as an additional prize for the winner, Comes with 12 Stickers and party hats. 

Gold
All of the above plus a random single Mini spot prize, and a Wooden Spord with certificate for last place. Comes with 16 Stickers and party hats. 

THIS IS A PROMOTIONAL SUPPORT ITEM FOR TOURNAMENTS AND EVENTS- PLEASE DO NOT ORDER THIS PRODUCT WITHOUT ASKING GOBLIN KING GAMES VIA EMAIL FIRST!

products.title: Swamp of Suffering Scatter Terrain
products.body_html:
Only Trolls and the most foolhardy adventurer would set foot in the Swamp of Suffering by choice, but if that's where the moonstones are growing then fortune favours the brave. Just watch out - there are creatures lurking below the slime!

This set will contain 22 pieces of finely cast resin. Supplied unpainted.

products.title: Machburg Market Scatter Terrain
products.body_html:
Machburg is the bustling capital of Tauber and its markets are second to none. As the merchants set up shop bright and early, is that the faint blue glow of moonstones they see peeking up through the cobbled streets?

This set will contain 14 pieces of finely cast resin. Supplied unpainted.

products.title: Forsaken Forest Scatter Terrain
products.body_html:
Near the centre of the Isle is the Forsaken Forest, a strange place packed with scurrying critters, enormous mushrooms and even some talking trees.

This set will contain 15 pieces of finely cast resin. Supplied unpainted.

products.title: Bumbleton Farm Scatter Terrain
products.body_html:
The idyllic hamlet of Bumbleton is a sleepy and peaceful place, that is until something a lot more valuable than turnips is spotted growing in the fields!

This set will contain 14 pieces of finely cast resin. Supplied unpainted.
